europe_now.title: French Protest Restrictions
europe_now.summary: French authorities have moved to ban or curb non-union protests over the weekend in an effort to prevent further violent unrest. President Emmanuel Macron instructed local officials to implement the restrictions following recent clashes.

sources.headline: 🔴Live: Authorities in Lyon and Marseille ban all protests Saturday

europe_now.title: Ukraine Conflict Updates
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that recent deadly attacks show no change in Russia's attitude toward the war. Meanwhile, both nations continue to exchange strikes as diplomatic discussions proceed.
